tokenPlaceholder.message: Token issued in the yt-gui settings screen

note.message: Enable the server under "Settings → Browser integration" in yt-gui and paste the token shown there into the field above. Use the same port as yt-gui (default 8718). In case yt-gui falls back when the port is busy, the extension automatically tries 8718–8720.

popupNote.message: The output container (MP4/MKV/WebM) follows the yt-gui app settings.
